```chart
type: line
title: Quoted years
data:
```

```chart
type: line
title: Numeric years
data:

    - {year: 2020, v: 1}

encoding: {x: year, y: v}
```

```chart
type: bar
title: Missing markers
data:
  inline:
    - {k: a, v: "n/a"}
    - {k: b, v: "1,234"}
    - {k: c, v: "NA"}
    - {k: d, v: 4}
encoding: {x: k, y: v}
```

```chart
type: line
title: Calendar comma
data:
  inline:
    - {d: "2026-01-01", v: "1,234"}

encoding: {x: d, y: v}
```
